design_philosophy: A polished, calm, warm-neutral studio workspace operating system for media teams managing multi-IP Instagram content. Replaces generic CRM clutter with dense, scannable, progressive-disclosure interfaces. Prioritizes sticky matrix tables, visual calendar placement, right-hand context panels, and distinct IP brand identities.

instructions_to_main_agent.header_and_navigation: Render a sticky top bar (height h-14) with global search, persistent role/demo switcher ('Founder', 'BO Producer', 'HPN Editor', 'Distribution Manager'), stream toggle pill (All / BO / HPN), notification count indicator, and quick '+ Create Idea' CTA. Sidebar must be clear with 7 distinct nav routes and data-testid attributes.
instructions_to_main_agent.data_testid_requirement: Every interactive button, input, tab, select, row, cell, and card MUST have a explicit data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='nav-command-room', data-testid='idea-card-brief-tab', data-testid='matrix-cell-hpn-mon').
instructions_to_main_agent.matrix_and_calendar: Implement sticky header rows and sticky first columns for matrix and network calendar. Never horizontal-scroll the whole page; keep internal scroll containers clean with overflow-x-auto. Use color badges for IPs and clear state badges for statuses. Support click to open the right persistent context side panel.
instructions_to_main_agent.context_side_panel: The persistent right-hand drawer (w-80 lg:w-96) shows the active idea/cell details with tabbed inspection (Brief, Page Versions, Anchored Comments with replies, Distribution placement). Ensure top overlay backgrounds are semi-opaque/blurred and NEVER fully transparent.
instructions_to_main_agent.idea_modal_progressive_disclosure: Rich Idea Card modal supports 6 tabs: Brief, Page Versions (per-IP hook & caption variations), Production & Review (slide editor for Carousels / Reel preview), Distribution, Performance, Activity.
instructions_to_main_agent.command_room: Show 4 core cards: (1) Network Posting-Status matrix (required vs planned vs confirmed), (2) Yesterday's Performance breakdown (Good/Average/Bad with metrics), (3) 6-Day Performance Cycle cohort trend graph, (4) BO Bank Health & Calendar Horizon indicator cards.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Avoid generic centered layouts and uniform full-screen gradients.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition like transition: all. Always specify transition-colors, transition-opacity, or transition-transform.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Maintain clean left-aligned studio hierarchy.
NEVER use generic emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for UI icons. Use Lucide icons or SVG vectors exclusively.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes for testing.
Ensure header background is non-transparent (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 or solid bg-[#FAF8F5]) so elements behind it never clash.
